get.summary: Code - Find A Facility by its Provider Code
UNLocode - Find Facilities By UNLocode and Code Provider
get.description: Returns facilities at the given UNLocode. By default the full result set is returned as an array; if it is too large for a single response, what fits is returned as the paged envelope with a 'nextToken'. Providing 'limit' (or 'nextToken') switches to paged responses: an object containing 'facilities' (up to 'limit' results, max 1000) and 'nextToken', an opaque token passed back on the next request to continue where the previous page ended ('nextToken' is null on the final page).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of facilities per page (1-1000). Providing this switches to a paged response envelope.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous paged response. Pass it back unchanged to retrieve the next page.

get.summary: Find Facilities Last Updated Within a Date Range
get.description: Returns facilities whose last updated datetime falls within the provided range. Both 'updatedAfter' and 'updatedBefore' must be provided and may be no more than six months apart; a wider range returns a validation error. Values may be an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime; a date-only 'updatedBefore' is inclusive of the whole day. Each returned facility includes a 'lastUpdated' datetime. By default the full result set is returned as an array; if it is too large for a single response, what fits is returned as the paged envelope with a 'nextToken'. Optionally pass 'geofenced=true' to return only facilities with a geofence, or 'geofenced=false' for only facilities without one. Providing 'limit' (or 'nextToken') switches to paged responses: an object containing 'facilities' (up to 'limit' results, max 1000) and 'nextToken', an opaque token passed back on the next request to continue where the previous page ended ('nextToken' is null on the final page).

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Start of the range, must be no more than six months before 'updatedBefore'

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: End of the range, must be no more than six months after 'updatedAfter'

parameters.name: geofenced
parameters.description: When 'true' only facilities with a geofence are returned; when 'false' only facilities without one

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of facilities per page (1-1000). Providing this switches to a paged response envelope.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous paged response. Pass it back unchanged to retrieve the next page.

lastUpdated.description: The datetime the facility was last updated

message.example: Date range between 'updatedAfter' and 'updatedBefore' must not exceed six months

searchScore.description: A relevance score calculated by the search engine indicating how well this facility matches the search query. Higher scores indicate a better match for the specific query. The score is based on factors like term frequency and inverse document frequency, and is not a percentage or a fixed-range value; its magnitude is relative to other results for the same query.

post.summary: Change Request - Submit/amend an edit to an existing facility
post.description: Submit (or same-day amend) a change request for an existing facility: any mix of field changes, a proposed coordinate, and/or a proposed geofence (GeoJSON FeatureCollection). Requires the contributor group. Body: facilityCode, codeProvider, trustGrade, and at least one of fieldChanges / proposedCoordinate / geoJson.

post.summary: Change Request - Propose a brand-new facility
post.description: Propose a new facility. Body: proposedFacility (POST /facilities shape, unLocode mandatory, no code), optional geoJson boundary, trustGrade, remarks. A candidate code is allocated and returned; it is NOT accepted until an approver confirms the request.

GeographicalFeature.description: When provided will always include a 'Polygon', may also include a centroid of the geofence is also provided as a 'Point'.

formattedAddress.title: Formatted Address - A single line address for the facility from the structured address.
formattedAddress.example: 123 Main St, Springfield, Illinois, 62704, United States of America

Facility.description: Outlines the Facility, note if an 'aliasCode' is provided it indicates that a searched for code is deprecated in favour of the `code` see https://docs.bic-code.org/guides/bic-facility-code/alias-codes

facilityManaged.description: Indicates whether the facility is actively managed.

codeRequested.title: Code Requested
codeRequested.description: Indicates whether a new facility code was requested and created (true) or an existing facility was matched and returned (false)

items.description: A linear ring is a closed LineString with four or more positions. The first and last positions are equivalent, and they MUST contain identical values; their representation SHOULD also be identical. A linear ring is the boundary of a surface or the boundary of a hole in a surface. A linear ring MUST follow the right-hand rule with respect to the area it bounds, i.e., exterior rings are counterclockwise, and holes are clockwise.

GeoJSon fundamental geometry construct. A position is an array of numbers. There MUST be two or more elements. The first two elements are longitude and latitude, or easting and northing, precisely in that order and using decimal numbers. Altitude or elevation MAY be included as an optional third element. Implementations SHOULD NOT extend positions beyond three elements because the semantics of extra elements are unspecified and ambiguous. Historically, some implementations have used a fourth element to carry a linear referencing measure (sometimes denoted as "M") or a numerical timestamp, but in most situations a parser will not be able to properly interpret these values. The interpretation and meaning of additional elements is beyond the scope of this specification, and additional elements MAY be ignored by parsers.

coordinates.description: A single position (longitude, latitude, and optional altitude)

trustGrade.title: Trust Grade
trustGrade.description: The knowledge of which the geofence is based on

category.title: Feature Category
category.description: At-least one feature must be 'FACILITY' if specifying categories, if no categories are specified the default is 'FACILITY'

remarks.title: General Remarks
remarks.example: Facility X renamed to Facility Y

TrustGrade.title: Trust Grade
TrustGrade.description: The provenance of the requested change, declared by the requester. Any trustGrade values inside submitted GeoJSON feature properties are ignored and replaced server-side with this value.

FieldChange.title: Field Change
FieldChange.description: One proposed text-field change. 'before' is the value as seen at submission time so reviewers can detect the record changing underneath the request.

label.description: Optional display label for the field

before.description: The value as seen when the change was proposed

ChangeRequestPost.title: Change Request Post Schema
ChangeRequestPost.description: A change request against an EXISTING facility. Must include at least one of fieldChanges, proposedCoordinate or geoJson. One request per facility per user per day: re-submitting the same day amends the earlier request in place.

remarks.description: Optional free-text note shown to reviewers (sanitised, max 150 characters)

proposedCoordinate.description: Proposed new facility coordinate (WGS-84 decimal degrees)

geoJson.description: Proposed geofence as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection (Polygon features only; coordinates in [longitude, latitude] order)

NewFacilityRequestPost.title: New Facility Request Post Schema
NewFacilityRequestPost.description: A proposal for a brand-new facility. The proposedFacility uses the same shape as POST /facilities (unLocode is mandatory, no code is posted). A candidate facility code is allocated and returned immediately, but it is NOT an accepted code until a reviewer confirms the request.

geoJson.description: Proposed geofence as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection (may also be supplied as proposedFacility.facility.geographicalFeature)

proposerRole.description: Why the requester is proposing this facility: they are the facility owner/operator, or they act on the owner's behalf

remarks.description: Optional free-text note shown to reviewers (sanitised, max 150 characters)

BasicAuth.description: Used only on `POST /oauth/token` to exchange your `username:password` for a JWT. All other endpoints require Bearer authentication.

BearerAuth.description: Required on every endpoint except `POST /oauth/token`. Use the `accessToken` returned by `/oauth/token` as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.
